mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather, featuring 78 degree temperatures and partly cloudy skies over Fireman's Park, with an air quality index of 52.

In city news, Verona is proud to showcase a new public art installation titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics by local artists at Century School, and residents are reminded to check their voter status at MyVote.wi.gov for the upcoming general election.
There is plenty to do around town starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness and Hop Haus Trivia, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In a review of calls from August 24 through August 31, the Verona Police Department noted that they successfully handled a report involving ding-dong-ditchers who were caught by officers.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Snickers Swirl, and since Culver's is open until 10 PM, there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
